day.headline: A Pig day — Rabbit and Goat are in step.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Pig — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Sign the thing. It's been ready far longer than you have.

reasons: Tiger pairs with Pig — a harmonious day
signs.message: That middle-ground plan pleases nobody. Say the version you'd actually pick.

reasons: Pig's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Run it through the wash today. You'll drive completely differently.

signs.message: You'd do it if they asked twice. Say yes now.
